title: Laws
source: project.json CLawGroup::LoadKey (0x129710: no keys of its own, every key a law) and CLaw::LoadKey (0x129380: `allow`, `cost`); CLaw : CModifier (class hierarchy), so other keys are modifier kinds

file.desc: every key is a law group (CLawGroup's loader; nothing else is accepted at either level)

law_group.desc: a law group: every key is a law's name (CLawGroup::LoadKey has no keys of its own)

law.desc: a law: `allow` and `cost`, then falls through to CModifier::LoadKey for any other key - a modifier kind; which names that takes is not read, so an unknown one is reported softly

cost.desc: what the law costs to adopt
